LISA local adaptive inference

Source: R/lisa.R
lisa.Rd

Applies post-statistic bilateral filtering to an observed statistic map and matched null maps, then estimates voxelwise FDR in filtered-statistic space. This is a local-adaptive companion to scale-space energy inference.

Usage

lisa(
  stat_vol = NULL,
  mask = NULL,
  q = 0.05,
  tail = c("pos", "neg", "two"),
  null_spec = NULL,
  n_perm = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  filter = lisa_bilateral(),
  p0 = 1,
  monotone = TRUE,
  scale_n_null = 30L,
  backend = c("neuroim2", "reference", "adjoin_sparse"),
  store_filtered_nulls = FALSE
)

Arguments

stat_vol

Optional 3D Z-equivalent statistic map. Defaults to null_spec$stat_vol. For convenience, stat_vol may also be a null_spec object, in which case null_spec is inferred.

mask

Optional mask override. Defaults to null_spec$mask.

q

FDR level.

tail

One of "pos", "neg", or "two".

null_spec

A null_spec object. Its stat_vol, mask, draw, and n_perm slots define the default observed map and null maps.

n_perm

Optional number of null draws to use. Defaults to all draws in null_spec; may not exceed null_spec$n_perm.

seed

Optional random seed set before consuming null draws. Most null_spec factories are deterministic by draw index, but this keeps LISA aligned with other permutation-facing neurothresh methods.

filter

LISA filter specification from lisa_bilateral().

p0

Conservative null proportion for the empirical FDR estimator.

monotone

Whether to enforce monotone q-values over evidence strength.

scale_n_null

Number of early null maps used for fixed range-scale estimation when filter$scale = "sd_first_30_nulls".

backend

Filtering backend.

store_filtered_nulls

Whether to store the full permutation-by-voxel filtered null matrix in extras. Defaults to FALSE; inference uses streaming tail counts either way.

Value

A neurothresh_result with LISA q-values in pvals and the filtered statistic map in extras$filtered_stat.
